sn12.46:1.2: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn12.46:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ katham sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || 3
sn12.46:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama so karoti paṭisaṃvediyatīti || ||
sn12.46:2.2: So karoti so paṭisaṃvediyatītī kho brāhmaṇa ayam eko anto || || 4
sn12.46:3.1: Kim pana bho Gotama añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvediyatīti || ||
sn12.46:3.2: Añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvediyatīti kho brāhmaṇa ayaṃ dutiyo anto || ||
sn12.46:3.3: Ete te brāhmaṇa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || || 5
sn12.46:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.46:3.9: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || 6
sn12.46:4.1: Evaṃ vutte so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.46:4.2: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama || pe||
sn12.46:4.3: Upāsakam maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti || ||
